Arbitrary real mode binaries cannot be loaded directly by LILO.  However, if
they are made to look like a "kernel image loaded LOW," then LILO can be
induced to load them, thinking they are an out-of-date kernel image.

BIOS Data Area (EBDA), which intrudes upon the 0x9000 segment.  The start

// ROT13 is an encryption algorithm that works
// by shifting(rotating) the alphabet by 13 letters
FUNCTION ROT13(Data : STRING) RETURNS STRING
    DECLARE NewData : STRING
    DECLARE Ch : CHAR
    DECLARE AsciiValue : INTEGER

    NewData <- ""
    FOR i <- 1 TO LENGTH(Data)
        Ch <- MID(Data, i, 1)
        IF ('a' <= Ch AND Ch <= 'z') OR ('A' <= Ch AND Ch <= 'Z') THEN
            AsciiValue <- ASC(Ch) + 13
            IF AsciiValue > ASC('z') OR (Ch <= 'Z' AND AsciiValue > ASC('Z')) THEN
                AsciiValue <- AsciiValue - 26
            ENDIF

FUNCTION Factorial(x : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    IF x = 0 THEN
        RETURN 1
    ELSE
        RETURN x * Factorial(x-1)
    ENDIF
ENDFUNCTION
